content_sections.text: Age relaxation for all posts: ST 5 years relaxation included in 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for MRVC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Special recruitment drive for Scheduled Tribes candidates. Selected candidates shall be deputed for Supervising works related to Civil, Electrical & Signalling and Telecommunication. Candidates must execute a Surety Bond of Rs. 1 Lakh to serve the Company for two years. Desirable: Candidates possessing Post Graduate Degree in relevant Technical Subject will have added advantage.

rows.qualification: Four years full-time bachelor's degree in BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with not less than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA.
rows.experience: Minimum 02 years of post-qualification working experience in relevant field of Civil engineering.

rows.experience: Minimum 02 years of post-qualification working experience in relevant field of Electrical engineering.

rows.qualification: Four years full-time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering or M.Sc Electronics OR a combination of any sub stream of basic streams.
rows.experience: Minimum 02 years of post-qualification working experience in relevant field of S&T engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MRVC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid. Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Four years full-time bachelor's degree in BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with not less than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Experience required: Minimum 02 years of post-qualification working experience in relevant field of Civil engineering. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 40,000-1,40,000. Qualification required: Four years full-time bachelor's degree in BE/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with not less than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Experience required: Minimum 02 years of post-qualification working experience in relevant field of Electrical engineering. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 40,000-1,40,000. Qualification required: Four years full-time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering or M.Sc Electronics OR a combination of any sub stream of basic streams. Experience required: Minimum 02 years of post-qualification working experience in relevant field of S&T engineering. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 40,000-1,40,000.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The period of contract will be initially for a period of two years, extendable on yearly basis on satisfactory performance and mutual consent. Designated as 'Project Engineer' and on completion of one year designated as 'Senior Project Engineer' with enhanced perks subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How Will MRVC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Preliminary screening of applications received from candidates by mail. Shortlisting of eligible candidates up to 5 times the notified vacancies based on engineering marks and experience. Interview by a nominated Committee. Final selection on merit based on interview, qualification and post qualification experience. Interview by a nominated Committee based on performance in interview, qualification and post qualification experience.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copy of original application Copies of certificate in proof of qualification Copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate) Copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card) Self-Attested copy of ST certificate Copy of document regarding experience, last served and others

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MRVC Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Duly filled in application should be sent to DGM/HR, Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected] . Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I). Email it on or before 24 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No train/bus fare/ TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation.
